concerns.text: Task T014 validates SC‑005 (signal‑rule compliance) even though SC‑005 is marked `[deferred]` in the specification, creating a direct conflict between the spec and the task list.

Task T015 runs `src/utils/cpu_check.py` which imports `torch` to assert `torch.cuda.is_available() is False`. Importing the `torch` library introduces a GPU‑dependent package, violating FR‑006 (CPU‑only pipeline) and Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene / CPU‑only constraint).
